dedupe_keys.name: d1 3 benchmark report on wake models at the wind farm scale

description: Pierre-Elouan Réthoré and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed EERA-DTOC comparisons evaluate wake-model performance using Horns Rev and Lillgrund wind-farm cases. The source reports overprediction of maximum wake losses and discusses uncertainty in measured wind direction as a possible influence. The comparison does not isolate one confirmed error mechanism. The case supports assessment of wake-model behaviour against operational evidence. The associated private SCADA observations are not inferred to be publicly downloadable. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
